locations.name: Tycho Scrapyard
locations.desc: Scrap dealer in lunar orbit. This is where it all began.

locations.name: Kármán Ring
locations.desc: Large trading station in Earth orbit, with a shipyard.

locations.name: Habitat L4
locations.desc: Remote habitat. Nobody asks where the goods come from.

locations.name: Achilles Debris Field
locations.desc: Remains of the war fleet. Free wrecks, but no traders.

locations.name: Ice Chunk KX-7
locations.desc: Asteroid of ice and ore. Mining it (demolish) yields water ice and ore.

locations.name: Kepler Outpost
locations.desc: Abandoned research base. Lots of loot, lots of locks, nobody to trade with.

locations.name: Hephaistos Refinery
locations.desc: Industrial plant. Pays well for ore, ice and scrap.

shipyard.name: Shuttle Lumen
shipyard.desc: Small and economical. Two rooms, one thruster.

shipyard.name: Freighter Bairn
shipyard.desc: Lots of cargo space, three thrusters, room for crew.
